'''Terr'skiar''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Terr'skiar system/Legends|Terr'skiar system]], a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region's]] [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Nightroad/Legends|Nightroad]] and the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']] linked it to the [[Pizilis system/Legends|Pizilis system]] and the [[Coachelle system/Legends|Coachelle]] and [[New Apsolon system/Legends|New Apsolon systems]], respectively, while the [[Terr'skiar Pass]] route connected it to the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector's]] [[Bissillirus system/Legends|Bissillirus system]]. Terr'skiar served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Terr'skiar [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Terr'skiar was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-10.<ref name="TEA" />
